events.title: Demo Update: Enemy Quirks, More Techniques, Engravings, Special Pages, Difficult
events.summary: Thank you for playing the Ink & Lore demo. Acting on your feedback ("it gets repetitive once techniques run out", "the enemies all behave the same"), we have rebuilt combat, items, equipment and the map. The enemies have personalities now 13 ordinary enemies, 7 elites and the boss each have a quirk. When two or more Block Guardians gather, they brace together, then all strike the same ally on the next turn. The Scribble Puppy fixes on one of you, and the Blurred Hound hides behind its friends. events.title: Demo Update: Improved Usability and Balance
events.summary: Thank you for playing the Ink & Lore demo! Based on your feedback, we've updated the demo. Here are the main changes. Title Screen On your first launch, the game now starts at the title screen, so you can adjust settings before you begin. Added a "Quit Game" button. Audio The BGM was too loud, so the default volumes are now Master Volume 50%, BGM Volume 50%, and SFX Volume 70%. UI Battle When you select a card, it's now clearer how to play it or cancel. events.title: Ink & Lore is joining Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Ink & Lore will take part in Steam Next Fest, running October 19–26, 2026. A free demo will be available during the festival. You'll be able to descend the first book of a 99-floor picture-book dungeon, fighting with consumable cards that vanish once they're used. This world is a picture book that someone stopped drawing — and the deeper you go, the more the artwork comes apart. Dates October 19, 10:00 AM – October 26, 10:00 AM (Pacific Time) We'll announce the demo here the moment it goes live.
